reviews.original: Li⁺ hop barrier underestimated 60%+ → ~3 orders in conductivity
reviews.statement: A barrier error changes an Arrhenius hop rate under specified temperature and prefactor assumptions. Conductivity error is not determined by the barrier alone.
reviews.reason: The proved exponential factor concerns a scalar rate. A conductivity conclusion also needs a transport model. This review does not verify the original material-specific 60% estimate or the proposed correction mechanism.
missingPremises: Carrier populations, jump geometry, network and correlation model
reviews.reviewedBy: Codex specification review; not independent physical validation
